items.name: style
items.title: Pesto UI Style
items.description: Pesto UI's tokens, accent themes, Geist fonts, motion system and base layer. Every component depends on it, so add it first.

theme.animate-travel: travel-bounce var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-out-back), travel-squish var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-in-out-circ)
theme.animate-travel-slide: travel-slide var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-out-back), travel-slide-squish var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-in-out-circ)
theme.font-sans: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

light.animate-travel: travel-bounce var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-out-back), travel-squish var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-in-out-circ)
light.animate-travel-slide: travel-slide var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-out-back), travel-slide-squish var(--duration-travel) var(--ease-in-out-circ)

55%.translate: calc(var(--tw-translate-x) + var(--travel-lean) * var(--travel-dir-x, 0)) calc(var(--tw-translate-y) + var(--travel-lean) * var(--travel-dir-y, 0))

80%.translate: calc(var(--tw-translate-x) + var(--travel-lean) * 0.3 * var(--travel-dir-x, 0)) calc(var(--tw-translate-y) + var(--travel-lean) * 0.3 * var(--travel-dir-y, 0))

.gradient-sky.background-image: radial-gradient(90% 110% at 12% 96%, #b7a2f2 0%, transparent 58%), radial-gradient(120% 100% at 18% 4%, #82aaee 0%, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(110% 130% at 92% 18%, #a6cdf7 0%, transparent 62%), radial-gradient(85% 85% at 62% 72%, #dcebfc 0%, transparent 58%)

.gradient-sunrise.background-image: radial-gradient(95% 110% at 10% 88%, #f2a0b4 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(100% 100% at 88% 10%, #f7d468 0%, transparent 58%), radial-gradient(90% 90% at 82% 88%, #f6b34f 0%, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(70% 80% at 42% 34%, #fbe1b8 0%, transparent 55%)

.gradient-blossom.background-image: radial-gradient(95% 100% at 14% 10%, #f7c8e3 0%, transparent 58%), radial-gradient(100% 110% at 88% 86%, #ec8ec4 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(80% 90% at 78% 18%, #d9b1f0 0%, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(70% 80% at 40% 78%, #fadef0 0%, transparent 55%)

.gradient-meadow.background-image: radial-gradient(100% 120% at 12% 90%, #2f9e70 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(95% 100% at 88% 12%, #93d7b6 0%, transparent 58%), radial-gradient(85% 95% at 84% 84%, #48c19d 0%, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(70% 80% at 46% 40%, #bae6d0 0%, transparent 52%)

@utility reveal-skeleton.transition: opacity var(--reveal-duration) var(--ease-in-out-quart), filter var(--reveal-duration) var(--ease-in-out-quart)

@utility reveal-content.transition: opacity var(--reveal-duration) var(--ease-in-out-quart), filter var(--reveal-duration) var(--ease-in-out-quart), translate var(--reveal-duration) var(--ease-in-out-quart)
